constraints.as_written: 35 °C ambient for extended periods and at 40 °C on peak days
constraints.source: The plant shall reject the full heat load at 35 °C ambient for extended periods and at 40 °C on peak days, and bidders shall show approach temperatures for both cases
The liquid cooling design point is facility water at 45 °C
The liquid cooling design point shall be facility water up to 45 °C, and bidders shall state maximum water inlet and expected outlet temperatures
Prefabricated cooling equipment shall suit outdoor use at ·20 to +45 °C, or the local 20-year extreme if more stringent, with corrosion protection tested to ISO 12944-6 or equivalent
